## ANN'S CONFIRMED PREFERENCES

*(Extracted from iamheer@outlook.com reply, 2026-04-28)*

### Must-Have Experiences
- Sacred temples, meditation spaces
- UNESCO historical sites
- Pre-WWII / 8th-century history
- Dawn / early morning visits (before crowds)
- Shrines with natural settings (forested, lanterns, deer)
- Cultural depth over commerce

### Explicit Rejections
- Shopping districts (Ginza, etc.) — Ann said first itinerary "leaned too heavily toward tourist attractions"
- Crowded tourist bus routes
- Commercial / retail experiences

### Pricing Requirements
- **Per-person pricing must be clearly visible** — not group totals only
- 3-tier structure (Premium A / Mid-Range B / Budget C) for every component
- Side-by-side total table (per-person AND group)
- Daughters need a budget tier that works at their level independently

### Lodging Requirements
- Kyoto: Premium ryokan (the splurge — Ann specifically requested this, 2 nights only)
- Tokyo + Osaka: Mid-range or budget acceptable
- **All properties: 1 room with 2 queen beds** (confirmed by Ann 2026-04-29 — parents + daughters sharing to manage daughters' budgets)
- Ryokan exception: Traditional tatami room, 4 futon sets — no queen beds. Must verify 4-person capacity at booking.
